gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-ysabeau: Bold and blocky, Pixelify Sans looks cut from strips of equal width, while Ysabeau sweeps along beneath it in curves that never pinch shut. And over a longer passage that softness carries the eye forward without any snagging.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-ysabeau-infant: Ysabeau Infant has outward-pointing terminals, like a pair of tongs, and it sits under Pixelify Sans in a plain sans voice. But the heading's chunky, uniform letters push forward while the body stays friendly and contemporary beside them.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office reads modern and open, with every curved letter leaving its ends unclosed. Yet across a longer stretch it stays easy on the eye, a quiet counterpart to the constant, unshaded strokes of Pixelify Sans.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-ysabeau-sc: Pixelify Sans draws a marker-like, unvarying line throughout. Ysabeau SC answers with a visibly gaping c at any size, and if the heading is made small, that bold pixel charm shrinks fast beside the sans.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zalando-sans: Strokes with no thick or thin emphasis define Pixelify Sans, giving the heading a stamped, game-screen feel. And Zalando Sans follows with curves left open at the ends, so a longer stretch of text moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zalando-sans-exp: Chunky, stamped, and a bit playful. Pixelify Sans cuts every letter at a single depth, and Zalando Sans Expanded follows with wide gaps and c tips that keep their distance, so a longer passage stays spacious and clean.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zalando-sans-sem: Rope-fine strokes, pixel-sharp shapes. Pixelify Sans brings that crafted, expressive look up top, while Zalando Sans SemiExpanded adds open-mouthed curves on c, e, and s, and the pairing's strongest quality is how differently the two draw a letter.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: ZCOOL XiaoWei moves with a calm shift in weight from stem to serif, and its curves never clog where they turn. Pixelify Sans is flat and contrast-free by comparison, so if the heading is made small, the body would hold more character than it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-: Every stroke of Pixelify Sans is the same bold width, with a c bent wide open. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique gives it a plain sans partner whose crossbar and stem match in weight, so the pair feels modern and tidy.

Smooth and approachable, the body text has open-mouthed curves with no hairlines and no swells. Zen Kaku Gothic New is the quiet half, and the pair's strongest quality is how it lets Pixelify Sans be the loud one.
